{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.62

|gr1= GUI Control - Tree View

|descr= Sets the color of left picture of a tree item defined by path when that item is disabled.

|s1= control [[tvSetPictureColorDisabled]] [path, color]

|p1= control: [[Control]]

|p2= path: [[Tree View Path]]

|p3= color: [[Color|Color (RGBA)]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_control tvSetPictureColorDisabled [[0], [1,0,1,1]];</sqf>
